response: Panton-Valentine leucocidin (PVL) is not significantly associated with the pathogenesis of Staphylococcus aureus bacteraemia in the UK. According to the available data, only 1.6% of S. aureus isolates from bacteraemic patients were PVL-positive, and all of these were methicillin-susceptible S. aureus (MSSA). This low incidence suggests that PVL-positive S. aureus are not of particular significance as causative agents of S. aureus bacteraemia in the UK.
